visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a white T-shirt, stands in a hallway with a white upper wall and blue lower section. Above a doorway is a yellow 'MIND YOUR HEAD' warning sign. He looks at the camera, then turns and walks into a white corridor that leads toward a parking garage visible in the distance. (2) Close-up shot of a retail display. Three white cuboid pastries shaped like Mahjong tiles with 'Zhong', 'Fa', and 'Bai' characters sit on a wooden lattice shelf next to a price tag showing 'NT$168'. A second shot shows a large red gift box containing 24 similar Mahjong-themed pastries priced at 'NT$1366'. (3) The man sits at a professional mahjong table covered in green felt. He is accompanied by two women; one has blonde hair and a black top, the other wears glasses and a beige shirt. He presents a small pack of the pastries to them. (4) Close-ups show the women unwrapping the plastic packaging. The pastries are golden-brown squares inside, topped with white chocolate or icing depicting Mahjong characters. (5) The blonde woman takes a large bite of a pastry, looking at the camera. The dark-haired woman in glasses also eats, examining the filling. (6) The man, now wearing a black baseball cap with 'BRIDGES' text, takes a bite of the 'Zhong' (Red Dragon) pastry. He chews and talks enthusiastically to the camera, gesturing with the half-eaten cake.
